description: Lists the websites in the person's Jaybird Digital account, sorted by name, with each one's id, name and live address. Websites started with start_website while the account was connected, or opened with their editKey, are listed under startedWebsites (up to 20, kept ones first). An account with none gets an empty list. Needs the person to connect their account; called without one, it asks them to sign in.
name: list_sites
title: List Your Websites
